newsitem.title: UK: Lanica shares suspended pending announcement.
newsitem.headline: Lanica shares suspended pending announcement.

text.p: Shares in British investment group Lanica Trust Ltd were suspended temporarily on Monday pending an announcement, the London Stock Exchange said.

Lanica said on Sunday "a company in which it has an investment" would approach Britain's Co-Operative group to discuss the possible purchase of certain non-food businesses. The Sunday Times newspaper said Lanica was expected to make a 500 million stg bid for Co-op's petrol station, undertaking, chemist, optician and department store businesses.
Lanica was last quoted at 1,937.5p, up 300p on the day.
Shares in Lanica, incorporated in the Channel Island of Guernsey, staged a phenomenal rise last year after entrepreneur Andre Regan took over when the stock was trading at 203p.
They are currently trading within sight of their 12-month high of 2,100p.
